<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/inspection-templates/{templateId}/versions/{version}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Publishes version N of a custom checklist (ADR 0015). A published version is IMMUTABLE: the same content again answers 200 and changes nothing, other content under a published version is 409 `template-version-immutable`; a new version is a new number. An inspection keeps a snapshot of the version it was opened from, so a later version never rewrites history. The built-in template ids are read-only (409 `template-is-built-in`). Item codes are lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique in the template; at most 100 items; an item without a `holdReason` holds a failed trailer for `QUALITY`. A malformed template is 422 `validation`. Raises nothing.
